text: My main symptom is Severe pain and swelling in the left knee. I also have Pain intensifying over 2 months, Painful awakenings during night, No relief with ibuprofen.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Giant Cell Tumor of Bone.

The "soap bubble" lytic lesion in the distal femur, combined with pain at night and normal inflammatory markers, is classic for this benign but locally aggressive tumor. I will recommend surgical consultation for a biopsy or curettage to confirm the diagnosis and plan treatment.
